business_summary: Kureha Corporation manufactures and sells functional materials, specialty chemicals, and plastics in Japan and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Advanced Materials, Specialty Chemicals, Specialty Plastics, Construction, and Other Operations. The Advanced Materials segment offers polyphenylene sulfide, polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), processed polyglycolic acid products, carbon fiber, and bead-shaped activated carbon products. The Specialty Chemicals segment provides therapeutic agents for chronic kidney disease, agricultural and horticultural fungicides, caustic soda, hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, monochlorobenzene, para-dichlorobenzene, and ortho-dichlorobenzene. The Specialty Plastics segment offers household plastic wraps, drain bags for kitchen sinks, plastic food containers, cooking sheets, PVDF fishing lines, polyvinylidene chloride film, automatic filling and sealing machines for food packaging. The Construction segment provides civil engineering and construction contracting, and construction supervision services. The Other Operations segment offers industrial waste treatment and environmental processing facilities; physiochemical analysis, measurement, testing, and inspection services; and transportation and warehousing, and medical services. It serves to various application such as agriculture, fishery, medical and welfare, energy, infrastructure, transportation, construction industry, automobile, daily necessities, packaging materials, home appliances, interior, and factory. The company was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Kureha Corporation은 일본 및 해외에서 기능성 소재, 특수 화학 물질, 플라스틱을 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 고급 소재, 특수 화학, 특수 플라스틱, 건설 및 기타 운영이라는 5개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 첨단 소재 부문에서는 폴리페닐렌 설파이드, 폴리비닐리덴 플루오라이드(PVDF), 가공된 폴리글리콜산 제품, 탄소 섬유 및 구슬 모양 활성탄 제품을 제공합니다. 특수 화학제품 부문은 만성 신장 질환, 농업 및 원예 살균제, 가성소다, 염산, 차아염소산나트륨, 모노클로로벤젠, 파라디클로로벤젠 및 오르토디클로로벤젠에 대한 치료제를 제공합니다. 특수 플라스틱 부문에서는 가정용 플라스틱 랩, 주방 싱크대용 배수 백, 플라스틱 식품 용기, 요리 시트, PVDF 낚싯줄, 폴리염화비닐리덴 필름, 식품 포장용 자동 충진 및 밀봉 기계를 제공합니다. 건설부문은 토목공학 및 건설 계약과 건설 감독 서비스를 제공합니다. 기타 운영 부문은 산업 폐기물 처리 및 환경 처리 시설을 제공합니다. 물리화학적 분석
